title: The Man Who Survived Two Atomic Bombs: Tsutomu Yamaguchi #shorts
description:
Did you know this story? 👇

The true story of Tsutomu Yamaguchi, the man who survived both atomic bombs, Hiroshima and Nagasaki, in August 1945.
Around 160 people are believed to have lived through both blasts, but Japan officially recognized only one of them, and not until 2009.

title: What If You Landed on Every Planet Without a Spacesuit?
description:
Would you go to Titan just to fly? 👇

What would happen if you landed on every planet without a spacesuit? We rank the Sun, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, Mars and Titan from deadliest to most survivable.
Including the true story of NASA technician Jim LeBlanc, who was exposed to near vacuum in 1965 and survived.
